title: Implement Canvas Setup & Management module
description:
In the first MODULE script block, implement canvas setup and management:
- Get canvas element and 2D context
- Set canvas size to fill viewport (account for control panel)
- Handle window resize events to maintain canvas size
- Detect orientation changes (portrait vs landscape) and reposition control panel
- Implement clearCanvas() function that fills canvas with background color (#F5F5DC)
- Preserve canvas content during orientation changes by:
  * Saving current canvas to temp ImageData before resize
  * Restoring ImageData after resize
- Store canvas state in global object: {ctx, canvas, width, height}
Technical notes:
- Use window.innerWidth/innerHeight for viewport size
- Listen to 'resize' event for orientation changes
- Canvas dimensions must match display size (width/height attributes, not CSS)
Reference: docs/plans/2025-12-16-toddler-paint-design.md Section 'Canvas Management'

title: Implement Brush Engine module
description:
In the second MODULE script block, implement the brush drawing engine:
- Create drawBrushStroke(x, y, color, size) function that:
  * Sets globalAlpha to 0.65 (65% opacity for layering effect)
  * Sets fillStyle to the color parameter
  * Uses arc() to draw circle at x,y with radius=size/2
  * Enables antialiasing (imageSmoothingEnabled=true)
  * Fills the circle
  * Restores globalAlpha to 1.0
- Create drawCursorPreview(x, y, color, size) function that:
  * Saves current canvas state
  * Sets globalAlpha to 0.3 (30% preview opacity)
  * Draws circle outline (strokeStyle) in the color
  * Restores canvas state
- Store brush state: {color, size, isDrawing}
- Initialize with: color='#FF1493' (hot pink), size=85px
Technical notes:
- Use ctx.beginPath(), ctx.arc(), ctx.fill() for circles
- Circle position is center, so radius = size/2
- Smooth edges via imageSmoothingEnabled
Reference: docs/plans/2025-12-16-toddler-paint-design.md Section 'Brush Behavior'

title: Implement Application Bootstrap module
description:
In the sixth (final) MODULE script block, bootstrap the application:
- Initialize canvas and get context
- Set random starting color:
  * Pick random index from the 8 color array
  * Set as active color
  * Update color button selection state
- Set starting brush size to 85px (medium)
- Initialize control panel layout based on current orientation
- Set up cursor preview on canvas:
  * Hide default cursor (cursor: none on canvas)
  * On pointermove: clear and redraw cursor preview at pointer position
  * Preview shows circle matching current color and size
- Add custom cursor CSS: canvas has cursor: none
- Focus canvas element for accessibility
- Dispatch initial setup complete event
Technical notes:
- Use Math.random() * 8 | 0 for random color index
- Cursor preview should not leave trails (clear previous before drawing)
- All modules should be initialized before this runs
- This is the APPLICATION block, not a reusable MODULE
Reference: docs/plans/2025-12-16-toddler-paint-design.md Section 'Initial State' and 'Code Architecture'

title: Test toddler-paint.html on multiple devices and fix issues
description:
Comprehensive testing and bug fixing:
- Desktop browser testing:
  * Test with mouse input (painting, color selection, size changes, clear)
  * Test fullscreen mode (enter via button, exit via ESC)
  * Test window resize and orientation simulation
  * Verify cursor preview shows correctly
- Touch device testing (phone/tablet if available, or browser dev tools touch emulation):
  * Test single-touch painting
  * Test multi-touch painting (2+ fingers simultaneously)
  * Test color change mid-stroke (should update all active strokes)
  * Test pinch/zoom is prevented (shouldn't zoom canvas)
  * Test fullscreen mode on mobile (verify button hides, ESC or back exits)
  * Test portrait and landscape orientations
- Visual verification:
  * Buttons are large enough (min 60px)
  * Selected color has visible glow + scale effect
  * Brush strokes have correct opacity (65%) and layering works
  * Canvas background is off-white (#F5F5DC)
  * Control panel is white and well-positioned
  * Cursor preview is visible and matches brush
- Console check: no errors on load or during use
- Fix any bugs found during testing
- Update meta description if needed
Reference: docs/plans/2025-12-16-toddler-paint-design.md Section 'Quality bar'

title: Implement Fullscreen Toggle module
description:
In the fifth MODULE script block, implement fullscreen functionality (adapted from toddler-time.html):
- Check if Fullscreen API is supported (document.fullscreenEnabled)
- Position button in corner opposite to control panel
- Button behavior:
  * Visible when NOT in fullscreen
  * Hidden (display: none) when IN fullscreen
  * Click: request fullscreen on document.documentElement
- Icon: SVG with expand/fullscreen symbol (copy from toddler-time.html lines 241-244)
- Listen for 'fullscreenchange' event:
  * Update button visibility based on document.fullscreenElement
  * Hide button when fullscreen active
  * Show button when fullscreen exits
- ESC key automatically exits fullscreen (browser default, no code needed)
Technical notes:
- Request fullscreen on documentElement (not just canvas) to hide browser chrome
- Button styling: 46x46px min, rounded corners, semi-transparent bg like toddler-time.html
- Handle vendor prefixes if needed (webkit, moz)
Reference: docs/plans/2025-12-16-toddler-paint-design.md Section 'Fullscreen Mode'

title: Register toddler-paint.html with tools list and commit
description:
Final steps to register the new tool:
1. Run tool discovery script:
   node scripts/update-tools-list.js
2. Verify index.html was updated with 'Toddler Paint' entry
3. Stage all changes:
   git add toddler-paint.html index.html docs/plans/2025-12-16-toddler-paint-design.md
4. Commit with message:
   'Add Toddler Paint: touch-friendly paint app for toddlers'
5. Sync bd:
   bd sync
6. Push to remote:
   git push
Technical notes:
- The update-tools-list.js script auto-detects .html files in root
- It converts 'toddler-paint.html' to display name 'Toddler Paint'
- Pre-commit hook may auto-run bd sync
- Verify tool appears on index.html homepage
Reference: CLAUDE.md Section 'Adding a new tool' and 'Session close checklist'

title: Create HTML structure and base styling for toddler-paint.html
description:
Create the basic HTML file structure for toddler-paint.html with:
- DOCTYPE, html, head, body tags
- Meta tags: charset=UTF-8, viewport, description='Touch-friendly paint app for toddlers with bright colors and simple controls'
- Title: 'Toddler Paint'
- HTML comment for provenance
- Canvas element with id='paint-canvas'
- Control panel div with id='control-panel'
- Fullscreen button with id='fullscreen-btn'
- Embedded <style> block with:
  * CSS reset (margin:0, box-sizing, html/body 100% height)
  * Body: overflow hidden, touch-action manipulation
  * Canvas: position absolute, background #F5F5DC (off-white), touch-action none
  * Control panel: position absolute, background white, display flex (will be styled more in later task)
  * Fullscreen button: position absolute, styled like toddler-time.html
- Empty <script> blocks with MODULE comments for each module (6 total per design doc)
Reference: docs/plans/2025-12-16-toddler-paint-design.md

title: Implement Control Panel UI module
description:
In the fourth MODULE script block, implement control panel with responsive layout:
- Panel positioning logic:
  * Portrait (height > width): top edge, horizontal layout (flex-direction: row)
  * Landscape (width > height): left or right edge (shorter), vertical layout (flex-direction: column)
  * Update position on window resize
- Create 8 circular color buttons (filled with colors):
  * Colors: Hot Pink #FF1493, Sky Blue #87CEEB, Lime Green #32CD32, Sunny Yellow #FFD700, Orange #FF8C00, Purple #9370DB, Brown #8B4513, Black #000000
  * Button size: max(60px, 15% of viewport short dimension)
  * Shape: border-radius 50% (circular)
  * Selection indicator: box-shadow glow + transform scale(1.1)
  * Click handler: set active color, update selection state, dispatch 'colorChange' event
- Create 3 rounded-square control buttons:
  * Bigger (green #22c55e, '+' icon): increase size by 15px (max 150px)
  * Smaller (orange #f97316, '-' icon): decrease size by 15px (min 20px)
  * Clear (red #ef4444, '✕' icon): call clearCanvas()
  * Button size: same as color buttons
  * Shape: border-radius 12px
- Add visual divider between color buttons and control buttons
Reference: docs/plans/2025-12-16-toddler-paint-design.md Section 'Control Panel UI Details'

title: Implement Multi-touch Paint Handler module
description:
In the third MODULE script block, implement multi-touch painting with Pointer Events:
- Track active pointers in Map: pointerId -> {x, y, lastX, lastY}
- Listen for pointerdown on canvas:
  * Add pointer to active map
  * Draw brush stroke at pointer position
  * Set pointer capture (setPointerCapture)
- Listen for pointermove on canvas:
  * If pointer is active, interpolate between last position and current
  * Draw brush strokes along the path (every 5-10px for smooth lines)
  * Update last position
- Listen for pointerup/pointercancel:
  * Remove pointer from active map
  * Release pointer capture
- When brush color changes (via colorChange event):
  * All active pointers immediately use new color
  * Continue drawing with new color without lifting
Technical notes:
- Pointer Events API handles both touch and mouse
- Use pointer.clientX/clientY for coordinates
- Convert to canvas coordinates: account for canvas position/size
- Interpolation prevents gaps in fast strokes (Bresenham-like)
Reference: docs/plans/2025-12-16-toddler-paint-design.md Section 'Multi-touch Support'
